name: Secessionist movements of Canada
notAnIdeology: The Wikipedia article is a regional overview of separate movements (Quebec sovereignty, Western and Alberta separatism, Acadian, Newfoundland, Cascadia) and their parties, not a single set of political beliefs; the only shared aim is secession, while the movements differ on economics and social questions (for example the social democratic Parti Québécois versus right-leaning Alberta separatist parties). The Quebec strand is already covered by quebec-nationalism and sovereigntism.
